Class Rectangle

java.lang.Object
com.cooke.shapes.Shape
com.cooke.shapes.TwoDimensionalShape
com.cooke.shapes.Rectangle
public class Rectangle extends TwoDimensionalShape
Rectangle Class Creates a Rectangle object with a length and a width; The rectangle's area is calculated when a new rectantgle is created and when either side length is adjusted. filename: Rectangle.java creation date: 20261027
Author:
Lawrence Cooke
